shared_elements: low relief carving of figures on a flat vertical surface
horizontal register/band containing a row of repeated figures
animals shown in profile (birds/quadrupeds in A; small animals led in B)
figures arranged in a repeating sequence along a band
justification: The only real correspondence is the generic device of stacked horizontal registers containing a row of repeated profile figures, plus the presence of animals in profile in both. Otherwise the content diverges completely: A shows isolated schematic beasts (raptor-like heads, quadrupeds, a large fox-like animal) with no human presence and no framing ornament, while B shows a procession of naturalistically proportioned robed human figures holding hands and leading animals, framed above and below by rosette bands.
